skill_name: Compare and contrast the use of AI in the fields of healthcare and education.
workflow: AI is being used in both healthcare and education to automate and optimize processes, analyze massive data sets, and provide personalized recommendations. In healthcare, AI applications include diagnosing and treating diseases, predicting medical outcomes, and helping make medical decisions. In education, AI is used for personalized learning and providing real-time feedback. AI is also aiding in grading and generating learning materials.
